payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate through string, split into maximal segments of allowed characters, add n*(n+1)//2 substrings for each segment length n.
payload.rationale: No dynamic programming is used; the algorithm is a simple two-pointer scan with combinatorial arithmetic. dp_1d_state is chosen as the least unfitting DP subtype due to a conceptual 1D 'current segment length' state, but it is not DP.
